' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'set -euo pipefail' 'CONFIG_DIR="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/local-climate-link"' 'PROPS_FILE="${LCL_ALPHA_SIGNING_PROPERTIES:-$CONFIG_DIR/alpha-signing.properties}"' 'KEYSTORE_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/alpha-signing.jks"' 'KEY_ALIAS=lcl-alpha' 'mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"' 'chmod 700 "$CONFIG_DIR"' 'if [[ -e "$PROPS_FILE" || -e "$KEYSTORE_FILE" ]]; then' '  [[ -f "$PROPS_FILE" && -f "$KEYSTORE_FILE" ]] || { echo partial-alpha-signing-state >&2; exit 1; }' 'else' '  STORE_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"' '  umask 077' '  keytool -genkeypair -noprompt -keystore "$KEYSTORE_FILE" -storetype JKS -storepass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -keypass "$STORE_PASSWORD" -alias "$KEY_ALIAS" -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Local Climate Link Alpha, OU=Local Climate Link, O=Local Climate Link, L=Warsaw, ST=Mazowieckie, C=PL" >/dev/null 2>&1' '  printf "storeFile=%s

printf '%s\n' '# Android phone-alpha workflow' '' 'Use `pnpm android:phone-alpha` for physical Android alpha testing.' '' 'This command intentionally performs a clean install: before every phone-alpha install it runs `adb uninstall link.localclimate.app`, so previous local app data is discarded.' '' 'Phone-alpha builds use a persistent machine-local key under `~/.config/local-climate-link/`. The key and passwords stay outside Git and are never printed. `tools/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh` creates the key once and reuses it. If only part of the local signing state exists, it fails instead of silently rotating the identity.' '' 'When the local alpha properties file exists, Gradle debug builds use that stable alpha key. CI/sandbox builds without it may use the Android default debug key; physical phone installs must go through `pnpm android:phone-alpha`.' '' 'Release/Google Play signing stays separate and continues to use the existing `LCL_ANDROID_*` environment variables.' '' 'The old 2.0.8 phone build used a different Local Climate Link certificate whose private key is not available in the current development environment. The clean-install rule handles that historical mismatch, while the persistent alpha key prevents future local key drift.' > docs/release/android-phone-alpha.md
